column2:
API Endpoint: POST /api/sites/{site}/button-resources

Add buttons to a site (requires 'buttons' instance setting to be TRUE)
column7:
Required Fields: title, placement, button_style, order, status, type, content
Field Validations:
- placement: only 'navbar' or 'header'
- type: only 'link', 'modal', or 'scroll'
- button_style: only 0, 1, or 2
- content: URL if type=link, text if type=modal, element id if type=scroll (REQUIRED)
- icon: class name of icons (optional)
- class_name: max 50 chars (optional)
- property: JSON input only (optional)
- text_color/background_color: hash color code (#121212)
- String max limit: 100 chars (except content field for modal type)
